text:
lina: Quick ping — PR #4521 touching Dedicated VPC deploy config. CI secret-scan just flagged a potential AWS key in `deploy.yaml`. We need a quick sec check before today's merge slot. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4521

security-bot: [auto] Secret scanner found a high-confidence match in `infra/deploy/deploy.yaml` (line ~23). Pattern: `AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}` — please verify.

lina: Ugh, thanks bot. I think that might be an example left in a template. I'll add context in the PR but want sec eyes first.

ben: assigning to @maria for quick review — can you take it?

maria: on it, will take a look in ~30m. If it's just an example key we should redact and push a fix, then re-run the secret scan.

samir: quick Q — does this only touch Dedicated/VPC deploys or could the same template be used for Private/on-prem packaging? Trying to assess blast radius.

maria: scanning the diff now — it's in `infra/deploy/dedicated/values.yaml` specifically, but the template is shared via `infra/deploy/_common/` which is used by our on-prem build too. So risk exists if we promote the change without scrubbing.

security-bot: Suggestion: replace literal with a KMS reference and a placeholder, e.g. `credential_ref: "kms://cluster-deploy-key"` and update docs to call out that examples must be sanitized.

lina: OK I'll prepare a patch that replaces the example key with `REDACTED_EXAMPLE` and swap to a KMS reference in the templates. Also will add a short note in the PR description about on-prem sharing. Any preferred way to re-run only the secret scanner?

ben: run `./ci/scripts/secret-scan --pr 4521` locally or trigger `ci/secret-scan` job in the PR actions. If CI is green before 17:00 PT we can keep today's merge slot.

maria: :thumbsup: I can re-check once it's pushed. If scan clears and no other issues, I'll give sec-approve in the PR thread.

prs-queue-bot: Holding merge for PR #4521 until `sec/approve` label and all CI checks pass. Merge window: today.

lina: pushed fix at commit https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/commit/abc123 (patched templates, removed example key, added comment). Triggered secret-scan re-run.

security-bot: Secret scan re-run: no findings.

maria: Reviewed updated diff — templates look good, removed literal creds, replaced with `credential_ref` placeholder. Leaving one minor nit about a comment string, but not security blocking. sec-approve given in PR.

ben: Thanks everyone. I'll do the canary after merge and monitor logs. Merging after PR queue rules (canary -> promote).

lina: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will follow up with a short blameless note to the infra team to avoid future example creds in templates.

prs-queue-bot: PR #4521 merged to `main` and canary started.
